settings.intro: Get reminders on this device, even when Restart is closed.
settings.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
settings.testIntro: Send a test to check that they arrive.
settings.testScheduledHint: Goes through the scheduler, like a real reminder. Close the app or lock your phone to try it.
settings.disabled: Notifications are off for this device.
settings.testSent: {sent, plural, one {Test sent to # device.} other {Test sent to # devices.}}
settings.testPartial: Test sent to {sent} of {total} devices. The others didn't answer.
settings.testNoDevices: No device has notifications on yet.
settings.testNotDelivered: The test couldn't be delivered. Turn notifications off and on again on this device.
settings.testScheduledFor: Test scheduled for {time}. You can close the app now.
settings.rateLimited: You already have 5 tests waiting. Try again in a few minutes.

ios.title: Install Restart first
ios.body: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work in the app on your Home Screen. Install it, open it from there and turn them on in Settings.

settings.iosTooOld: Notifications need iOS 16.4 or later. Update in Settings → General → Software Update.
settings.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Try Safari, Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

denied.title: Notifications are blocked
denied.ios: Open the Settings app → Notifications → Restart, and turn on Allow Notifications. Then come back here.
denied.android: Long-press the Restart icon → App info → Notifications, and allow them. In the browser: tap the icon next to the address → Permissions → Notifications.
denied.desktop: Click the icon next to the address → Site settings → Notifications → Allow. Then reload this page.

settings.missingKey: Push isn't set up on this server: NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY is missing or invalid. Generate keys with npx web-push generate-vapid-keys and restart the app.

errors.permissionDismissed: Notifications weren't allowed. Tap Enable when you're ready.
errors.noServiceWorker: Couldn't start notifications on this device. Reload the page and try again.
errors.noServiceWorkerDev: The service worker isn't running. In development it's off unless NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_SW_IN_DEV=1 is set; or try npm run build && npm start.
errors.subscribeFailed: Couldn't turn on notifications. Try again.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save this device. Check your connection and try again.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.testFailed: Couldn't send the test. Try again.
errors.disableFailed: Couldn't turn off notifications. Try again.

test.title: 🔔 Restart test
test.body: It works! Reminders will arrive on this device.
test.scheduledBody: It works! Due {due}, sent {sent}. Reminders will arrive on this device.

review.title: 🗓️ Your week: {score, number, percent}
review.titleDelta: 🗓️ Your week: {score, number, percent} ({delta, number, ::sign-always percent})
review.body: Tap to review it and plan the next one.
